title: Tallinn Navalny solidarity
notes: Executed Freedom Square protest asks Russian authorities to release Navalny and reform Russian politics. Ancillary appeal to EU/other countries to pressure Kremlin retained; explicit Estonian governmental-policy demand not established. No count or end invented; 83 photos not people; registration/distancing not dispersal.

title: Narva Navalny solidarity on January23 and31
notes: Peetri Square to Russian Consulate Jan31; source also labels reused January23 Narva photographs. Retain both dates as linked foreign-target actions rather than count cities/days as qualifying events. Russia arrests/violence not Estonian responses; turnout/closure unknown.

title: Opposition MPs office entry and committee walkout
notes: Three MPs entered committee chair's office January8; opposition committee members walked out January9 over speaking/microphone restrictions. No >=50 public demonstration established; no automatic exclusion of all party-organized protests.

title: Greens nuclear moratorium digital petition
notes: Council approved petition wording Jan21, publication Jan22. Online discussion/signature collection is not simultaneous attendance; party council not established as public protest.

title: Same-sex marriage referendum advocacy and petition
notes: January7/14 updates concern amendments, defeat of referendum bill and petition around36000 signatures. No physical public protest established in this reading; signature number not crowd. Referendum defeat not coded as response to an unspecified gathering.

title: Tallinn anti-mask rally before January
notes: Article SaturdayNov28,2020 reports Friday afternoon action around200. Actual body recovered; metadata came from exact-title search epoch. No evidence this physical gathering continued into January; do not relabel by related Jan23 link.

title: April Tallinn restrictions and bill protest
notes: Original body and annual review place relevant action in April, not January. April police processing/crowd estimates must not be transferred into January.

title: Feministeerium retrospective Polish solidarity and online activities
notes: January18 editorial recalls past-year support of Polish women's solidarity protest without date/count or Estonian-policy demand; online book/craft sessions Jan28/30 are scheduled activities, not executed physical protest.
